Heading: Maryland General Assembly – Laws on Deepfakes
Intro: As of November 2026, Maryland has enacted four laws that address deepfakes: SB 360 (2025) on AI-made intimate images, SB 8 (2026) on identity fraud using AI or deepfakes, SB 141 (2026) on election deepfakes, and SB 221 (2026) on child sexual abuse material, including images made with AI. The 2026 session ended in April; the next begins in January 2027.
